Global X Digital Asset Issuer Limited Publishes 2026 Interim Financial Statements for the Period Ended 30 June 2026

September 25, 2026 - Global X Digital Assets Issuer Limited, the Issuer of cryptoasset ETPs listed on Deutsche Börse Xetra, SIX Swiss Exchange and the London Stock Exchange, has published its interim financial statements for the period ending 30 June 2026. The financial statements are available on Global X's website at: GX Issuer Interim Financial Statements_30_06_2026
Global X Digital Asset Issuer Limited is registered in Jersey (number 139150)
Registered office: 28 Esplanade, St. Helier, Jersey, JE23QA
The value of an investment in ETPs may go down as well as up and past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

Cryptoasset Exchange Traded Products (ETPs) are designed for financially sophisticated investors, who fully understand the risks of investing in a product with digital assets exposure and any investment should be monitored on a regular basis. Please refer to the section entitled "Risk Factors" in the relevant prospectus for further details of these and other risks associated with an investment in cryptocurrency ETPs. You should consult an independent investment adviser prior to making an investment in ETPs in order to determine suitability to your circumstances.

Cryptoassets are a high-risk investment and may not be suitable for all types of investor. Prospective investors should be aware that the price of the underlying asset(s) by which the securities are secured can demonstrate higher volatility than other asset classes and consequently the value of the securities may be extremely volatile. You must ensure that the nature, complexity and risks associated with cryptoassets are suitable for your objectives in light of your circumstances and financial position.
